claims: For the 2026 MLB season, NBC Sports features Jason Benetti as the lead play-by-play announcer for Sunday Night Baseball and Peacock games.
The all-star broadcast team includes studio analysts Clayton Kershaw, Joey Votto, and Anthony Rizzo, with Bob Costas and Ahmed Fareed hosting.
Matt Vasgersian is the Sunday Leadoff play-by-play announcer for 2026 NBC Baseball.
Bob Costas is the Sunday Night pregame host for 2026 NBC Baseball.
Booth analysts for 2026 NBC Baseball vary weekly.
Booth analysts for 2026 NBC Baseball include former MLB players connected to the participating teams.
NBC/Peacock holds rights for Sunday Night Baseball.
NBC/Peacock holds rights for postseason Wild Card games.
The format features Benetti paired with analysts from both participating teams.
The coverage marks NBC's return to regular MLB broadcasting after a 25-year break.
